content:
You are a research assistant. Use your websearch and webfetch tools to answer this GAIA benchmark question:

"In NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day on 2006 January 21, two astronauts are visible, with one appearing much smaller than the other. As of August 2023, out of the astronauts in the NASA Astronaut Group that the smaller astronaut was a member of, which one spent the least time in space, and how many minutes did he spend in space, rounded to the nearest minute? Exclude any astronauts who did not spend any time in space. Give the last name of the astronaut, separated from the number of minutes by a semicolon."

Steps:
1. Use websearch to find "Astronomy Picture of the Day January 21 2006" or "APOD 2006-01-21"
2. Use webfetch on the APOD page (https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/ap060121.html) to find the two astronauts
3. Identify the smaller astronaut and which NASA Astronaut Group they belonged to
4. Research all astronauts in that group and find who spent the least time in space as of August 2023 (excluding zero-time astronauts)
5. Calculate minutes rounded to nearest minute
6. Format answer as: LastName; Minutes

Please start by using websearch to find the APOD page.
